title: hyprwhspr configuration
description: Configuration schema for hyprwhspr speech-to-text system

oneOf.description: Physical key name such as capslock, rightmeta, or KEY_CAPSLOCK; decimal strings are interpreted as Linux evdev keycodes.

^whisper_prompt_[a-z]{2}$.description: Prompt used when transcribing this language, eg whisper_prompt_de

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE autocompletion and validation

primary_shortcut.description: Primary keyboard shortcut to trigger recording (e.g., 'SUPER+ALT+D')

secondary_shortcut.description: Optional secondary hotkey for language-specific recording (e.g., 'SUPER+ALT+I')

translate_shortcut.description: Optional hotkey that records like primary_shortcut and has the LLM translate the dictation into llm_translate_language before paste (e.g., 'SUPER+ALT+T'). Uses the llm_refine_* provider settings, whether or not llm_refine_enabled is on.

scratchpad_shortcut.description: Optional hotkey that records like primary_shortcut and has the LLM apply the dictation to the scratchpad draft instead of pasting it: new text is added, an instruction about the draft ('change X to Y', 'drop the last point') edits it (e.g., 'SUPER+ALT+S'). Uses the llm_refine_* provider settings, whether or not llm_refine_enabled is on.

scratchpad_paste_shortcut.description: Optional hotkey that pastes the scratchpad draft into the focused app when released, without auto-submit (e.g., 'SUPER+ALT+P').

scratchpad_speak_shortcut.description: Optional hotkey that reads the scratchpad draft aloud in scratchpad_voice; pressed again while reading, it stops (e.g., 'SUPER+ALT+R'). Needs an OpenRouter API key ('hyprwhspr config llm') and mpv, ffplay, pw-play or paplay.

cancel_shortcut.description: Optional shortcut to cancel recording and discard audio without transcribing (e.g., 'SUPER+ESCAPE')

recording_mode.description: Recording mode: 'toggle' (press to start/stop), 'push_to_talk' (hold to record), 'auto' (hybrid tap/hold), 'continuous' (keeps transcribing, auto-pastes on speech pause), 'long_form' (extended recording with pause/resume; requires long_form_submit_shortcut)

grab_keys.description: Exclusive keyboard grab. False is safer; true suppresses shortcut from other apps. Disable for compatibility with keyboard remappers (keyd, kmonad).

external_bindings.description: Disable hyprwhspr's keyboard shortcuts; a compositor or hotkey daemon bound to `hyprwhspr record toggle` drives recording instead. Formerly use_hypr_bindings.

selected_device_name.description: Specific keyboard device name (e.g., 'USB Keyboard'). Takes priority over path if both set.

keyboard_hotplug.description: Watch for keyboards plugged in after startup (pyudev) and attach them live, so docked/Bluetooth/USB keyboards work without restarting the service. True (default) enables this for any keyboard that passes the same checks as startup discovery (must emit every shortcut key). Set false to restore startup-only discovery.

keyboard_device_names.description: Optional allowlist of keyboard device names. When set, only listed devices are grabbed at startup AND on hotplug. Ignored if selected_device_name or selected_device_path is set. Null (default) = no name filter.

audio_device_id.description: PortAudio device index, or a PulseAudio/PipeWire source name (from `pactl list short sources`). The index can change on reboot; a source name is captured through the sound server, keeping any processing applied to it.

audio_device_name.description: Device or source name substring (more stable across reboots); a full PulseAudio/PipeWire source name is also accepted. Captured through the sound server so EasyEffects/noise suppression still apply. Prefix with `hw:` to open raw ALSA hardware instead, bypassing all sound-server processing.

audio_device_vendor_id.description: USB vendor ID for audio device (most stable identifier, from udev)

debug_recordings.description: Keep the last 3 raw recordings in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/hyprwhspr/recordings for debugging bad transcriptions.

keepalive_stream.description: Hold a silent input stream open between recordings so the mic stays warm (fixes 'paTimedOut' on some USB mics). Off by default; when on, desktops show the mic-in-use indicator continuously.

stream_start_retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait between stream.start() retries when PortAudio times out. Increase if your USB mic frequently fails on the first recording after idle.

audio_device_model_id.description: USB model ID for audio device (most stable identifier, from udev)

model.description: Whisper model to use for local transcription (e.g., 'base', 'base.en', 'small', 'medium', 'large-v3')

threads.description: Thread count for whisper processing; omit for auto = min(8, CPU count)

language.description: Language code for transcription (null = auto-detect, or 'en', 'nl', 'fr', etc.)

word_overrides.description: Dictionary of word replacements applied after transcription: {"original": "replacement"}

filter_filler_words.description: Remove common filler words (uh, um, er, etc.) from transcription output

filler_words.description: Filler words to remove when filter_filler_words is enabled

hallucination_markers.description: Stock phrases Whisper emits for non-speech audio; matching transcriptions are discarded instead of pasted

append_trailing_space.description: Append a space after each transcription: true always, false never, 'auto' skips it when the text ends in a CJK character

whisper_prompt.description: Prompt passed to Whisper to guide transcription style, for every language

whisper_prompt_en.default: Transcribe with proper capitalization, including sentence beginnings, proper nouns, titles, and standard English capitalization rules.
whisper_prompt_en.description: Prompt used for English audio; add whisper_prompt_<lang> keys for other languages

task.description: 'transcribe' outputs the source language; 'translate' translates speech into English. Supported by pywhispercpp and faster-whisper.

sampling_strategy.description: Whisper decoding strategy (pywhispercpp, faster-whisper). 'beam_search' tracks multiple candidates for better accuracy; 'greedy' is faster but lower quality. Locked at model load for pywhispercpp (restart to change).

beam_size.description: Number of candidate sequences tracked during beam search (beam_search only). Higher is more accurate but slower.

post_transcription_hook.description: Shell command run after preprocessing, before paste. Stdin receives the transcription; non-empty stdout replaces it. Empty stdout preserves the original text. Exit status 77 intentionally consumes the transcription and skips paste. Env vars HYPRWHSPR_MODEL and HYPRWHSPR_BACKEND are set. Subject to a 5s timeout; other errors pass through the original text.

llm_refine_enabled.description: Rewrite each dictation with an LLM before post_transcription_hook and paste. Cleans up punctuation, mis-hearings, self-corrections, repetition and rambling. Any failure pastes the original text. Configure with 'hyprwhspr config llm'.

llm_refine_provider.description: 'openrouter' uses OpenRouter with the API key stored by 'hyprwhspr config llm'. 'custom' uses llm_refine_endpoint_url, any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint (OpenAI, Groq, Ollama, llama.cpp); its optional key is stored as 'llm-custom'.

llm_refine_endpoint_url.description: Chat completions URL for the custom provider, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions or http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions. An API key is never sent over plain http to a non-local host.

llm_refine_model.description: Model id. Null uses the provider default (OpenRouter: anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5). Required for the custom provider.

llm_refine_prompt.description: System prompt replacing the built-in cleanup prompt. The dictation is sent as the user message inside <transcript> tags.

llm_refine_prompt_file.description: Path to a file holding the system prompt; takes precedence over llm_refine_prompt and is re-read for every dictation. 'hyprwhspr config llm prompt' creates one from the built-in prompt.

llm_refine_extra_instructions.description: Text appended to the active prompt, e.g. names to spell correctly or a preferred spelling variant, without replacing the built-in prompt.

llm_refine_temperature.description: Sampling temperature sent to the model. Null leaves it to the provider.

llm_refine_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the LLM. On timeout or any error the original text is pasted.

llm_translate_language.description: Language the LLM translates into for translate_shortcut and 'hyprwhspr record start/toggle --translate', given as a name or code (e.g. 'English', 'German', 'pt-BR'). Other dictations are not translated.

scratchpad_model.description: Model for scratchpad edits, on the llm_refine_* provider. Null = llm_refine_model (or the provider default).

scratchpad_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for one scratchpad edit. The LLM rewrites the whole draft, so this is longer than llm_refine_timeout. On timeout or any error the draft is kept unchanged.

scratchpad_clear_on_paste.description: Empty the scratchpad draft once it is pasted. 'hyprwhspr scratchpad undo' restores it.

scratchpad_voice.description: Voice the scratchpad draft is read aloud in ('hyprwhspr scratchpad speak', scratchpad_speak_shortcut, or the voice command). 'hyprwhspr scratchpad voice NAME' sets it.

scratchpad_speech_model.description: OpenRouter text-to-speech model that reads the scratchpad draft aloud, through https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/audio/speech.

scratchpad_speech_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for OpenRouter to synthesize one part of the scratchpad draft. A long draft is read in parts of about 1500 characters.

voice_control_enabled.description: Hands-free control by voice. The start word opens a quiet command session, the end word closes it, and a decision model picks what happens next: a dictation (pasted, raw, translated, or applied to the scratchpad draft), a scratchpad operation (paste, copy, undo, clear, read aloud), paste/copy of the last dictation, or a question to the voice assistant, answered aloud. The end word also stops any running recording. Needs a wake word engine (voice_control_engine) in the service's Python, an OpenRouter API key ('hyprwhspr config llm'), PipeWire or PulseAudio, and a local or REST backend; not available in long_form mode.

voice_control_engine.description: Wake word engine. openwakeword runs one trained model per word (pretrained names or custom .onnx files). sherpa runs a small open-vocabulary keyword spotter (sherpa-onnx, about 6 MB, CPU): any English phrase works as a word, with no training. vosk runs a small recognizer for one language (voice_control_vosk_model, about 40-50 MB, CPU) restricted to the two phrases: any words in its vocabulary, no training.

voice_control_start_word.description: Wake word that opens a voice command. With the openwakeword engine: a model name (alexa, hey_jarvis, hey_mycroft, hey_rhasspy) or a path to a custom .onnx model. With sherpa: any English phrase, such as 'hey computer'. With vosk: a phrase in the model's language, such as 'hej komputer'. Models download on first use.

voice_control_end_word.description: Wake word that ends a voice command or any recording; must differ from voice_control_start_word. Model name or .onnx path (openwakeword), or a phrase that does not begin with the start word (sherpa, vosk).

voice_control_threshold.description: Wake word score that counts as heard (openwakeword engine). Raise it if words fire by accident; lower it if they are missed.

voice_control_keyword_threshold.description: Trigger probability for a phrase (sherpa engine). Raise it if words fire by accident; lower it if they are missed.

voice_control_keyword_boost.description: Boost for each token of a phrase while decoding (sherpa engine). Raise it if words are missed; lower it if they fire by accident.

voice_control_vosk_model.description: Vosk model (vosk engine): a language code such as pl, de, fr, es, it, nl, ru, cs or en-us, whose small model downloads on first use, or a path to an unpacked Vosk model directory.

voice_control_vosk_confidence.description: Lowest confidence each word of a phrase needs to count as heard (vosk engine). Raise it if words fire by accident; lower it if they are missed.

voice_control_end_trim_seconds.description: Seconds of audio cut from the end of a command or recording the end word closed, so the word itself is not transcribed. A remnant left in the text is stripped too.

voice_control_max_command_seconds.description: A voice command still open after this many seconds is dropped.

voice_control_cues.description: Play quiet pings when a voice command opens and closes. Follows audio_feedback.

voice_control_decision_model.description: Decision model on OpenRouter's Decisions API that turns a command into an action, e.g. typesafe/jev-1.14, perplexity/pplx-decider-flash-v1.2, liquid/d1.1. Confidence scales differ between models; retune voice_control_min_confidence after switching.

voice_control_decision_endpoint.description: Decisions API URL. It receives the OpenRouter API key; plain http is refused except to localhost.

voice_control_decision_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the decision model.

voice_control_min_confidence.description: Decisions less confident than this count as not understood; language picks below it fall back to automatic detection or llm_translate_language.

voice_control_languages.description: Language codes a command can name, as the language to dictate in or to translate into. Empty: commands never set a language.

assistant_model.description: Model that answers voice assistant questions, on the llm_refine_* provider. Null = llm_refine_model (or the provider default).

assistant_prompt.description: System prompt for the voice assistant, replacing the built-in one (Jarvis: helpful, brief, dryly funny, written for speech). The current time and the wake words it must not say are appended to any prompt.

assistant_prompt_file.description: Path to a file holding the voice assistant's system prompt, read on every question, so edits apply without a restart. Wins over assistant_prompt; a file that can't be read is an error.

assistant_voice.description: Voice the assistant's replies are read in, with scratchpad_speech_model.

assistant_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the assistant's reply.

assistant_memory_minutes.description: A question asked within this many minutes of the last reply continues the conversation, so follow-ups keep their context. 0: every question starts fresh.

scratchpad_preview.description: Show the scratchpad draft in an overlay panel while you dictate into it, with the last change highlighted. Needs GTK4 and a layer-shell compositor (Hyprland, Sway, niri, ...); elsewhere, or when false, each change is shown in a desktop notification.

scratchpad_preview_seconds.description: Seconds the scratchpad panel stays visible after the draft changes. 0 keeps it on screen until the draft is pasted or cleared.

clipboard_behavior.description: True = clear clipboard after delay, false = keep clipboard contents

clipboard_settle_delay.description: Seconds between successful clipboard copy and paste; lower values may reduce compatibility.

clipboard_clear_delay.description: Seconds to wait before clearing clipboard (only used if clipboard_behavior is true)

paste_mode.description: Paste key combination, or null to auto-detect from the focused application.

hyprland_paste_backend.description: Hyprland paste and auto-submit backend. auto uses native dispatch with fallbacks; ydotool uses only ydotool and reports failures without fallback. Ignored on other desktops.

paste_keycode_wev.description: Wayland/XKB keycode as printed by wev for the key that types 'v'. Converted to Linux evdev by subtracting 8.

paste_keycode.description: Linux evdev keycode for the paste key. Default 47 = KEY_V (QWERTY). Set to the keycode for the physical key that produces 'v' on your layout.

ydotool_modifier_overrides.description: Physical key overrides for logical modifiers sent by ydotool, whether selected explicitly or used as a fallback. Named keys are recommended; positive Linux evdev keycodes are accepted for advanced configurations.

applications.description: Per-application injection behavior keyed by normalized focused-window identifiers. Set auto_paste to a key chord like 'ctrl+y', or false to disable injection entirely for that app (nothing pasted, clipboard left untouched).

oneOf.description: Paste key chord to send for this app, e.g. 'ctrl+y' or 'ctrl+shift+v'.
Disable injection while this app is focused: nothing is pasted and the clipboard is left untouched.

shift_paste.description: Back-compat: true = Ctrl+Shift+V, false = Ctrl+V, null = auto-detect. Only used if paste_mode is absent.

inject_mode.description: Direct-type injection mode, bypassing the clipboard entirely. null (default) = clipboard + paste keystroke; 'wtype' = wtype -- <text> (native Wayland, works in Kitty-protocol terminals); 'ydotool_type' = ydotool type -- <text> (works in Kitty-protocol terminals).

prefer_clipboard_paste.description: Force verbatim clipboard paste instead of direct typing on GNOME/Mutter. Direct typing (ydotool type) is only correct for ASCII text on a US layout; hyprwhspr already switches to clipboard paste automatically for non-US layouts or non-ASCII text, so set this only to force clipboard paste in all cases.

parakeet_cpp_device.description: Experimental Parakeet.cpp runtime; auto preserves a compatible installed runtime.

qwen3_asr_device.description: llama.cpp runtime variant; auto prefers an installed runtime, then a hardware Vulkan GPU, then CPU

qwen3_asr_timeout.description: Qwen3-ASR sidecar request timeout in seconds

qwen3_asr_ctx_size.description: Qwen3-ASR llama-server context size in tokens; null keeps llama.cpp's default (32000). The KV cache (~112 KiB/token for the 1.7B model) scales with this

rest_endpoint_url.description: Full HTTP or HTTPS URL for remote transcription endpoint

rest_fallback_endpoint_urls.description: Ordered mirror URLs of rest_endpoint_url, tried when an endpoint is unreachable or returns HTTP 429/5xx

rest_api_key.description: DEPRECATED: API key for authentication. Use credential manager instead.

rest_headers.description: Additional HTTP headers for remote transcription

rest_body.description: Additional body fields for remote transcription

rest_timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds for REST API calls

websocket_provider.description: Provider identifier for WebSocket credential lookup (e.g., 'openai', 'google', 'elevenlabs')

websocket_url.description: Explicit WebSocket URL (auto-derived from provider if null)

websocket_sample_rate.description: Custom server audio rate. null = protocol default.

websocket_session_format.description: Custom openai-realtime session shape. flat for older servers (NeMo-Speech.cpp); transcribe only.

realtime_live_typing.description: Experimental: type words while you speak. Needs an append_only model.

websocket_live_text.description: Custom server live text. revisable: OSD preview. append_only: words never change; enables live typing.

realtime_timeout.description: Completion timeout in seconds for WebSocket transcription

realtime_buffer_max_seconds.description: Max buffer in seconds before dropping audio chunks

realtime_transcription_session_type.description: Transcribe-mode session type; 'realtime' for proxies that demand it

realtime_transcription_delay.description: Latency/accuracy delay setting for OpenAI continuous transcription models

realtime_conversation_history.description: OpenAI Realtime converse history: retain the session or delete completed turns

pywhispercpp_use_vad.description: Enable native Silero VAD for the pywhispercpp backend (strips silence, reduces hallucination loops). Auto-downloads the ~1MB ggml-silero VAD model on first use.

onnx_asr_model.description: ONNX ASR model name: Parakeet v3 (default), orukeet (optional INT8 fine-tune), or a custom model

onnx_asr_quantization.description: Quantization mode for ONNX ASR. 'int8' (default) or null for FP32. Orukeet ignores this.

onnx_asr_use_vad.description: Use Voice Activity Detection for recordings at or above onnx_asr_vad_min_duration

onnx_asr_vad_min_duration.description: Minimum recording duration in seconds before ONNX ASR routes audio through VAD

faster_whisper_device.description: 'auto' detects CUDA; falls back to CPU. Set explicitly if needed.

faster_whisper_compute_type.description: 'auto' uses int8 on CUDA and CPU. float16 (CUDA) or float32 trade memory for precision.

faster_whisper_vad_filter.description: Enable built-in Silero VAD to strip silence and reduce hallucination loops

cohere_transcribe_device.description: Device for the Cohere Transcribe backend. 'auto' detects CUDA and falls back to CPU.

cohere_transcribe_dtype.description: Compute dtype for Cohere Transcribe. GPU runs bfloat16 (the model's native precision); true float16 is not usable as it overflows the attention mask, so a 'float16' setting is treated as bfloat16. 'float32' forces full precision and is used on CPU.

cohere_transcribe_compile.description: Enable torch.compile for Cohere Transcribe (faster throughput; adds warmup on first call).

start_sound_volume.description: Volume multiplier for recording start sound

stop_sound_volume.description: Volume multiplier for recording stop sound

start_sound_path.description: Custom path for start sound (null = built-in ping-up.ogg)

stop_sound_path.description: Custom path for stop sound (null = built-in ping-down.ogg)

error_sound_path.description: Custom path for error sound (null = built-in ping-error.ogg)

mic_osd_enabled.description: Show recording status during recording. Shown as the animated overlay on layer-shell compositors (Hyprland, Sway, niri, KDE), or as desktop notifications on GNOME/Mutter (which has no layer-shell support).

mic_osd_style.description: Visualization style for the mic OSD overlay. 'waveform' shows the full themed waveform with transcript preview, 'vu_meter' a VU meter, and 'pill' a compact monochrome status pill with optional live transcript. Restart the service after changing.

mic_osd_pill_transcript_enabled.description: Show a live transcript above the pill OSD. Requires a realtime-ws backend that streams partial transcripts (OpenAI, ElevenLabs).

mic_osd_pill_transcript_word_limit.description: Maximum number of recent words shown above the pill.

mic_osd_pill_transcript_idle_timeout_ms.description: Hide the preview after this many idle milliseconds. 0 disables the timeout.

notification_timeout_ms.description: How long non-critical desktop notifications stay on screen, in milliseconds. These are also marked transient so they never pile up in the notification center. Critical errors ignore this and persist until dismissed. Note: GNOME Shell ignores notification timeouts and uses its own banner duration.

mute_detection.description: Enable mute detection to cancel recording when mic is muted

audio_ducking_mode.description: How to quiet other audio: 'duck' lowers every application stream's volume; 'pause' pauses MPRIS media players (browser, Spotify, mpv) and resumes them afterwards, ducking only what is left

audio_ducking_percent.description: How much to reduce volume BY (50 = reduce to 50% of original)

auto_submit.description: Send Enter key after pasting text (for chat/search inputs)

long_form_temp_limit_mb.description: Max temp storage in MB for long-form segments

long_form_auto_save_interval.description: Auto-save interval in seconds for long-form recording (default: 5 minutes)

long_form_auto_pause_seconds.description: Long-form auto-pause: after this many seconds of silence the recording stops keeping audio (paused indicator and a quiet ping) and resumes on its own when you speak again. 0 = off

long_form_silence_threshold.description: Audio level below which long-form auto-pause counts as silence. 0 = follow the room's noise floor

long_form_pause_word.description: Long-form mode wake word that pauses the session; say it again to resume. Speech is not recorded in between. Detected by voice_control_engine: an openWakeWord name (hey_jarvis, hey_mycroft, alexa, hey_rhasspy) or .onnx path, or a phrase for sherpa or vosk. Empty = off. Needs the engine installed and PipeWire or PulseAudio

continuous_silence_seconds.description: Seconds of silence before auto-pasting transcription in continuous mode

continuous_silence_threshold.description: RMS level below which audio is considered silence in continuous mode. 0 (default) = auto-calibrate from noise floor at session start. Set manually if auto-calibration misbehaves on your mic.

silence_timeout.description: Auto-stop recording after this many seconds of silence in toggle/auto/continuous modes. 0 (default) = disabled. The timer only arms after speech is detected, so it won't fire while you compose your first sentence.

push_to_talk_lock_seconds.description: Push-to-talk hold-to-lock: hold the key this many seconds and the recording latches on (hands-free). The next press ends it. External bindings must send `release` on key-up (`stop` never latches). 0 (default) = disabled, classic push-to-talk.
